lastCompletedStory.title: Preserve valid issueId-only merge-watch seed in the sidecar null-state GC

nextStoryContext: US-001 is now complete. The GC fix is in gcMergeWatchIfGarbage (exported from sidecar.ts): it preserves issueId-only seeds and deletes real garbage. The stale 'keeps the sidecar inert' comment in merge-watch.ts is removed. AC4 anti-shadow-mock regression tests and AC3 integration tests (with real-jq skipIf) are in test/release/merge-watch.test.ts. The file-size budget for src/commands/sidecar.ts was raised from 1045 to 1090.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story touched only Node.js builtins (node:fs, JSON.parse) and internal project code. No third-party npm/bun library was exercised.
